steps.title: Plate part: sketch the rectangle
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as plate.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the top).
Sketch tab > Create panel > Rectangle (Two Point Center): click the origin and drag.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 80 by 40. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Plate part: extrude
actions: Click Extrude. Distance A: 10 mm, upwards. Click OK.

steps.title: Plate part: clearance hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face. Place the centre on the centre of the plate.
Simple Hole. Diameter 9 mm (clearance for M8). Termination: Through All. Click OK.

steps.title: Plate part: round the corners
actions: Click Fillet. Radius 4 mm.
Pick the four vertical corner edges. Click OK. Save plate.ipt.

steps.title: Assembly: place the lower plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as bolted_joint.iam.
Click Place and choose plate.ipt.
Right click and pick Place Grounded at Origin, then press Esc.

steps.title: Assembly: place the upper plate
actions: Click Place, choose plate.ipt again and click once in the window to add a second copy.
Click Constrain. Type: Insert. Pick the top edge of the hole in the lower plate, then the bottom edge of the hole in the upper plate. Click OK.
Add a Mate constraint between a side face of each plate so they line up.

steps.title: Assembly: add the washer
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Click Place from Content Center. Fasteners > Washers > Plain. Pick an M8 plain washer (8.4 x 17 x 1.6).
Constrain > Insert: the washer bore onto the top edge of the hole in the upper plate.

steps.title: Assembly: add the bolt
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place from Content Center. Fasteners > Bolts > Hex Head. Pick an M8 x 40 hex head bolt.
Constrain > Insert: the underside of the bolt head onto the top of the washer.

steps.title: Assembly: add the nut
steps.command: Assemble tab > Component panel > Place from Content Center
actions: Place from Content Center. Fasteners > Nuts > Hex. Pick an M8 hex nut.
Constrain > Insert: the nut onto the bottom edge of the hole in the lower plate.
Save bolted_joint.iam.
steps.note: Content Center parts come with their threads and exact standard sizes. The hub models them simplified.
